text:
Professor William Kuskin teaches in the English department at University of Colorado - Boulder. Overall rating 4.5/5 from 29 ratings; average difficulty 2.9/5; 93.75% would take again.

Review 1 [ENGL1290] (quality=5.0, difficulty=2.0): Professor Kuskin is funny, and genuinely caring about all his students. The content is interesting, the books are entertaining, and the essays/projects are fairly graded. My only complaint is that the lectures felt drawn out or overly discussed a bit. Don't take it if you don't like comics, you'll be bored. But if you like art it's a great class.

Review 2 [ENGL2006] (quality=4.0, difficulty=2.0): this was a fun class. Kuskin is super passionate about his teaching. There was 2 essays. Easy grading on your comics. Overall good gen ed. Attendance wasn't all that mandatory.

Review 3 [ENGL2006] (quality=5.0, difficulty=1.0): Kuskin is the goat. Attendance isn't mando but there's 18 in class writings out of 26 classes. Drawing skills don't matter in this class which is a huge bonus. He's very knowledgeable and gives amazing feedback. Don't know how anyone could complain about this dude.

Review 4 [ENGL2006] (quality=5.0, difficulty=2.0): Even as someone not initially interested in comics, this class was super fun and engaging. Dr. Kuskin is a spectacular lecturer! Class was mostly discussions about assigned readings and student work (you can very easily not do the readings and still pass, but I would reccomend doing them anyways). Be ready to draw a ton of comics! Overall 10/10

Review 5 [ENGL2006] (quality=5.0, difficulty=1.0): Kuskin is always willing to work with his students and provides engaging and fun lectures

Review 6 [ENGL1290] (quality=3.0, difficulty=2.0): It's mostly just a discussion of the assigned reading every class. There are in class writings that are random that count toward your grade, but there is a lot of EC if you do miss a day. I took this as a gen ed hoping it would be interesting, but it was sooo boring. There's a lot of reading and the grading on the essays was kind of annoying.

Review 7 [ENGL1290] (quality=5.0, difficulty=3.0): Professor Kuskin is the best professor I've had at CU Boulder! He's a super cool person and amazing teacher. His class was so engaging and taught me so much about literature! The class is mainly discussion based with a few in class assignments. If there is one class I wish I could take again, it's this one! Can't recommend enough.

Review 8 [ENGL2006] (quality=5.0, difficulty=1.0): Always willing to help! The class was super interesting and it was more of a daily discussion of the readings.

Review 9 [ENGL2006] (quality=5.0, difficulty=3.0): I've never read comic books so I wasn't expecting to like this class, but Prof. Kuskin made it very enjoyable and interesting. The class was exciting because we were able to analyze the art, text, style, and colors in a way that gave a deeper understanding of what the author and illustrators were trying to portray. 10/10 would recommend.

Review 10 [ENGL2006] (quality=4.0, difficulty=3.0): Kuskin himself is really an awesome professor, he is an interesting lecturer and seems like a great guy. However, I just want to say this class is not the most entertaining unless you really love to read comics. Oddly requires a lot of artistic prowess, so I would not recommend the class itself unless you're dying to spend hours on making a comic.

Review 11 [ENGL2006] (quality=5.0, difficulty=2.0): Great guy. Invested in his students' wellbeing/enjoyment, and incredibly enthusiastic about the material. The readings are easy, so do them. He appreciates participation in lecture. Email him, he is happy to help you however he can. Three essays throughout the course.

Review 12 [ENGL3856] (quality=5.0, difficulty=3.0): Please take this class, Kuskin is an incredible professor. There is a bit of homework but it is all based around comic books and making them so its super fun!

Review 13 [ENGL2006] (quality=5.0, difficulty=2.0): Where do I even start with Kuskin? He's just the coolest professor I've ever had. He's so hilarious and you can tell he cares deeply about what he's teaching. He always responds to emails and connects with you on a personal level. Such a sweet guy, and the class is super interesting. There's a lot of reading but I can't complain- it's comic books!!

Review 14 [ENGL3856] (quality=5.0, difficulty=3.0): Kuskin is probably my favorite English professor at CU. I took his comic book class, and it was phenomenal. I'm not normally a comic book person, but he took the time with me outside of class to discuss things I was interested in, whether or not it was regarding the class. He's a genuinely good person, and I'm sad he doesn't teach other classes.

Review 15 [GIAN101] (quality=5.0, difficulty=4.0): Really a cool guy with a cool subject and even cooler personality.

Review 16 [ENGL3856] (quality=5.0, difficulty=3.0): Prof. Kuskin made me fall back in love with being and English major. I had taken 3 semesters of classes that had made me think I may have made the wrong choice, but the genre studies-the graphic novel course was a blessing. Great mixture of light and dark material, and the lectures were fantastic. His voices for comic characters are amazing.

Review 17 [MOOC] (quality=5.0, difficulty=2.0): Best teacher EVER ! He is so passionate ! He will make you love the subject no matter what !

Review 18 [COURSERAMOOC] (quality=5.0, difficulty=1.0): Engaging video persona for an online course made for stimulating learning. His enthusiasm emitted from the screen. Well created course material as well.

Review 19 [ENGL0000] (quality=5.0, difficulty=5.0): Best. Professor. Ever. Period. This class was a game changer. I think some of the other frustrated comments below have to do with courses that have teaching assistants who are doing the grading, so watch out for that. But take anything he teaches. You'll work hard, but you will get more out of this class than anything else you ever take.

Review 20 [ENGL4020] (quality=4.0, difficulty=4.0): By far the best professor I have ever had. The work is hard, sure, but it actually feels meaningful and is damn worth it. Take a class with Kuskin!

Review 21 [ENGL3856] (quality=5.0, difficulty=2.0): Absolutely wonderful professor. He knows so much about comics and graphic novels and wants to share as much of that knowledge as is humanly possible in one semester. Great guy. Excellent teacher. Energetic about the class every single day. You wont regret taking this guy's class.

Review 22 [ENGL3856] (quality=4.0, difficulty=3.0): I had a lot of interest in the topic (comics/graphic novels) before this class, and he managed to make me less interested as the class went on. pretty much the whole thing was close reading- if this isn't your thing, watch out! enthusiastic lecturer, but bs attendance policy. tough grader on papers, but end grade results were fair, even generous.

Review 23 [ENGL3856] (quality=1.0, difficulty=5.0): This is a terrible class. DONT TAKE IT. The class discussions are all about "taking a risk and there is no wrong answer". But when it comes to the assignments that is not the case. The essays are very vague and seemingly impossible to get above a C on. The comic project could be fun but they are overly critical and mean. Bad english class to take.

Review 24 [ENGL3856] (quality=5.0, difficulty=4.0): Good teacher = passionate teacher!! Have a lot of new favorite books after this class. It's hard to get an A though!

Review 25 [ENGL3856] (quality=4.0, difficulty=5.0): By far the best professor I have ever had!  I had zero interest in graphic novels before this class and it has been my favorite course so far!  He is a super passionate lecturer who could literally teach a class on tree bark and still have everyone hanging on his every word.  He is really helpful out of class as well.  Tough teacher but worth it!!!

Review 26 [ENGL3856] (quality=4.0, difficulty=4.0): Dr. Kuskin is awesome. He is so passionate about his lectures that it makes his students passionate about the material. I started off with no interest in graphic novels and was amazed by the end to see them as truly profound pieces of art. Dr. Kuskin is friendly, helpful, enthusiastic, brilliant, and very funny. He loves his students!

Review 27 [ENGL3899] (quality=3.0, difficulty=4.0): brilliant man. to get and A one should go to class, be creative and learn to analyze literature for all it's worth. graphic novels is a great class.

Review 28 [ENG2000] (quality=4.0, difficulty=4.0): Fun, energetic, invested, and makes otherwise boring reading material semi-interesting. Not the easiest grader, but still really cool. :]

Review 29 [ENGL2000] (quality=4.0, difficulty=4.0): Very good teacher, lots of fun. Just make sure you work hard on the papers if you want to get an A.
